description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Mahawa, Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabhas has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette content contains multiple notices under Section 10 A (1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically declaring that members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of the United National Party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government bodies, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including candidate registrations, vacancies, and electoral commission decisions.
